# orq_model_fusion (Resource)

A workspace Model Fusion: a virtual gateway model that combines independent answers from a panel of models through a judge and an optional synthesizer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orq_model_fusion" "research" {
  key    = "research-fusion" # immutable; forms the model reference
  preset = "quality"         # general | quality | budget | code | safety

  # 1 to 8 distinct chat models that answer independently.
  panel_models = [
    "openai/gpt-4o",
    "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5",
  ]
  judge_model = "openai/gpt-4o"

  # analysis needs an orchestrator_model to synthesize the final answer.
  synthesis_mode     = "analysis"
  orchestrator_model = "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5"

  max_tool_calls    = 4 # 0 to 20; defaults to 8
  feed_raw_to_synth = true
}

# The judge writes the final answer, so there is no orchestrator_model. The
# budget preset never uses web tools.
resource "orq_model_fusion" "budget" {
  key            = "budget-fusion"
  preset         = "budget"
  panel_models   = ["openai/gpt-4o-mini"]
  judge_model    = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
  synthesis_mode = "judge_writes_final"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `judge_model` (String) Model in `provider/model` format that judges the anonymized panel answers.
- `key` (String) Key that identifies the Model Fusion within the workspace and forms its model reference. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Changing this forces replacement.
- `panel_models` (List of String) One to eight distinct chat models in `provider/model` format, each answering independently.
- `preset` (String) Prompt preset applied to the panel, judge, and synthesis phases: `general`, `quality`, `budget`, `code`, or `safety`.
- `synthesis_mode` (String) `analysis` has a separate `orchestrator_model` synthesize the final answer; `judge_writes_final` has the judge write it.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Model Fusion is available to AI Gateway requests. Defaults to `true`.
- `feed_raw_to_synth` (Boolean) Whether raw panel answers are included in the synthesis input. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_tool_calls` (Number) Maximum Fusion-managed web tool calls per participating phase, between 0 and 20. Zero disables them. Defaults to `8`.
- `orchestrator_model` (String) Model in `provider/model` format that synthesizes the final answer. Required when `synthesis_mode` is `analysis` and not allowed otherwise.
- `web_tools` (Boolean) Whether the panel and judge phases get the provider-native web search tool. Defaults to `true`, except with the `budget` preset or `max_tool_calls = 0`, where it is always `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Model Fusion ID assigned by orq.
- `model_ref` (String) Workspace-qualified model reference to use in AI Gateway requests.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Model Fusions are imported by their id.
terraform import orq_model_fusion.example 01KYPDMVAJQDQVP2XZWM4ECYG9
```
